# Posted LinuxCNC output fixtures

- `freecad-pocket.ngc`: FreeCAD `linuxcnc_post` pocket output posted at https://forum.linuxcnc.org/38-general-linuxcnc-questions/50603-z-feed-rate-ignored (timestamp and comments shortened).
- `fusion-drill.ngc`: Fusion 360 LinuxCNC three-hole output posted at https://www.forum.linuxcnc.org/38-general-linuxcnc-questions/48533-job-freeze-on-simple-g0-z5.

These are real user-posted output examples. The tests use zero tool length for H1 and H11.
